## What's Changed

See the [full release notes](https://github.com/Seen-Tomorrow/blackwell-ops/releases/tag/{{tag_name}}) for details.

## Download

- **Setup installer:** `Blackwell_Ops_*_{{tag_name}}_x64-setup.exe`
- **Portable 7z:** `CORE_{{tag_name}}_x64.7z` (extract anywhere, no install)

## Quick Start

1. Download the installer or portable 7z above
2. Run the setup → it auto-detects your GPU and CUDA version
3. Point at your GGUF model folder
4. Launch an engine — first inference in minutes
